## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test` pass
- [ ] Docs updated (`README*.md`, `docs/`) if behaviour changed
- [ ] Any new number shown in the UI cites its file and field
- [ ] Tested against `pnpm demo` (or a copy via `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`), never against a real `~/.claude`
